mission.label: OUR MANDATE & CALLING
mission.heading: Mobilising believers to stand in the gap for the nations.
paragraphs: Nations Prayer and Fasting Network (NAPFAN) is a Christian ministry movement committed to raising, equipping, and uniting believers in devoted prayer, fasting, and spiritual vigilance for individuals, families, communities, churches, and nations.

At the core of our mandate is the biblical conviction of Ezekiel 22:30: God seeks for believers who will make up the hedge and stand before Him in intercession. When the Church unites with sincere humility and spiritual consecration, God heals the land and releases lasting transformation.

Through strategic prayer gatherings, discipleship teachings, and our annual 21 Day Fasting and Prayer programme, NAPFAN empowers believers across denominations and borders to walk in prevailing prayer authority.

founder.label: LEADERSHIP & MINISTRY STORY
founder.name: Pastor Emmanuel Olu Falodun
founder.title: General Overseer, Christ Salvation Victory Mission International | President – Nations Prayer And Fasting Network (NAPFAN)
paragraphs: Pastor Emmanuel Olu Falodun is the President of Nations Prayer and Fasting Network (NAPFAN) and the General Overseer of Christ Salvation Victory Mission International.

For more than three decades—beginning in 1994 with the landmark All Believers 21 Day Fasting and Prayer—he has carried an apostolic and prophetic mandate to call the body of Christ into deep consecration, fervent prayer, and strategic intercession for communities and nations.
founder.quote: When believers take their place in genuine intercession and fasting, they participate directly in what God is doing across nations.
